retained_native_failure.evidence: Observed fatal dialog and retained debugger thread report. Symbol-only relink maps its RVA near Vulkan PipelineBarrier::AddImage. No crash ZIP was captured; this is not a complete fault-context diagnosis.
retained_native_failure.mitigation: New managed-session configurations explicitly set vid_fullscreen=false. Windowed card saves pass; two earlier failures remain retained and the timer patch is not claimed to fix every native failure.

limitations: Two-client siege presentation remains poor on the shared GPU; see native-sync-presentation-results.json.
